reason: As a solo CA with just one trainee, the two-seat free pilot already covers our setup, so I have no reason to pay ₹12,990 upfront. After being burned by Jamku and desktop software that got cluttered and abandoned after two months, I refuse to spend money until a tool proves my trainee will actually stick with it.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If the free pilot reliably eliminates my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation and my trainee actively uses it past the two-month mark without abandoning it.
